headline: Interactive tools package omics meta-analysis, feature selection and enrichment workflows
label: Interactive Omics Analysis Tools
summary: Omics studies increasingly need reproducible, code-free access to ranked-feature meta-analysis, enrichment and multi-omics integration.
synthesis: The common thread is packaging omics analysis procedures for direct use, either through interactive interfaces or reproducible pipelines. MetaOmixTools provides a code-free web suite for Rank Product and RRA meta-analysis of ranked feature lists with functional enrichment, and THe Biom offers interactive visualisation and comparison of hybrid ensemble feature selection signatures across TCGA cancers and stages. AutoFlow, FishFeats and PEtab-GUI expose flow cytometry, single-cell spatial quantification and parameter estimation through Shiny, napari and graphical front ends, while moiraine and WESkit target reproducibility via automated multi-omics integration pipelines and GA4GH-compliant workflow execution. Interoperability is a second strand: pyBiodatafuse builds context-specific knowledge graphs across biomedical resources, and SummArIzeR clusters redundant cross-database enrichment results with LLM-based annotation. Several items address narrower problems, such as Smart-seq3 UMI retrieval. The novelty lies in pairing accessible interfaces with explicit provenance and standardised interoperability.
